text: Truly exceptional service. The seamless fussion of Afro-Carribean vibes, music, food and ambience makes the experience worth your while! 💯🔥

author: itssbey
text: Service is great and the food was very nice, lovely atmosphere. It was nice to taste a sweet version of Jamaican food, cocktails were really good as well.
